title: ByteDance Integrates Douyin, Feishu, and Volcano Engine to Accelerate AI Enterprise Service Expansion
excerpt: ByteDance has launched a new round of organizational adjustments focused on AI business, further strengthening the collaborative capabilities of Doubao, Feishu,
content_html:
ByteDance has launched a new round of organizational adjustments focused on AI business, further strengthening the collaborative capabilities of Doubao, Feishu, and Huoshan Engine in enterprise productivity scenarios, and accelerating the AI To B strategic layout.

According to the adjustment plan, the Feishu product team and the Doubao product team will be integrated to form a new Doubao product team, led by Zhao Qi, the head of Doubao. Xie Xin, the head of Feishu, will report to Zhao Qi. In terms of market, sales, and customer service, the Feishu GTM team will merge with the Huoshan Engine team to establish a new To B organization called "Creativity Service Platform," which will be responsible for the market, sales, and customer service of ByteDance's MaaS (Model as a Service) and SaaS cloud services. This new organization will be led by Tan Dai, the head of Huoshan Engine. Lin Chan, the head of Feishu sales, and Shi Zhijun, the head of Feishu strategy and marketing, will report to him.

After the adjustment, Feishu's existing products and services will remain unchanged, while it will collaborate more deeply with Doubao in enterprise productivity scenarios. It is reported that the Doubao Enterprise Edition, which was deeply involved in the development by the Feishu product team, has already started internal testing among some Feishu customers. The newly established Creativity Service Platform will also integrate ByteDance's service capabilities for enterprise customers, improving the efficiency of AI product implementation.

This organizational adjustment reflects ByteDance's further elevation of the strategic priority of AI To B business. As of June this year, the daily token call volume of the Doubao large model has exceeded 180 trillion, and Huoshan Engine maintains an important position in the public cloud MaaS market. Feishu's commercial growth continues to accelerate. By the second quarter of 2026, more than 90% of Feishu's new customers had already purchased Feishu AI products. According to statistics, based on the average consumption calculation in July, ByteDance's large model business ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) reached 4 billion USD, exceeding the total ARR of other domestic model companies.

At the FORCE Original Power Conference in June, ByteDance CEO Liang Rubo stated, "Climbing the peak of AI is the most important thing for ByteDance at present." The company will focus on AI development and promote the MaaS business of Huoshan Engine to become an important foundational business for ByteDance.

As enterprise AI applications enter the stage of large-scale implementation, ByteDance is building an integrated AI enterprise service system covering model capabilities, application scenarios, and commercial delivery by integrating model, office software, and cloud service resources.

content_html_zh:
字节跳动围绕AI业务启动新一轮组织调整，进一步强化豆宝、飞书、火山引擎在企业生产力场景的协同能力，加速AI To B战略布局。

根据调整方案，飞书产品团队和豆宝产品团队将整合，组建新的豆宝产品团队，由豆宝负责人赵琪领导。 Xie Xin, the head of Feishu, will report to Zhao Qi. 在市场、销售和客户服务方面，飞书GTM团队将与火山引擎团队合并，成立一个新的To B组织，名为“创意服务平台”，负责字节跳动MaaS（模型即服务）和SaaS云服务的市场、销售和客户服务。 这个新组织将由霍山引擎负责人谭代领导。 飞书销售负责人林禅、飞书战略与营销负责人施志军将向他汇报。

调整后，飞书现有产品和服务将保持不变，但将与豆宝在企业生产力场景上进行更深入的合作。 据悉，由飞书产品团队深度参与开发的豆宝企业版已经在部分飞书客户中启动内测。 新成立的创意服务平台还将整合字节跳动对企业客户的服务能力，提高AI产品落地效率。

此次组织调整体现了字节跳动对AI To B业务战略重点的进一步提升。 截至今年6月，豆宝大模型日均调用量已突破180万亿，火山引擎在公有云MaaS市场保持重要地位。 飞书的商业增长持续加速。 截至2026年第二季度，飞书90%以上的新客户已经购买了飞书AI产品。 据统计，按7月平均消费计算，字节跳动大模型业务ARR（年度经常性收入）达到40亿美元，超过国内其他模型公司ARR总和。

在6月份的FORCE原创力量大会上，字节跳动CEO梁如波表示，“攀登AI巅峰是字节跳动目前最重要的事情”。 公司将聚焦人工智能发展，推动火山引擎MaaS业务成为字节跳动重要基础业务。

随着企业AI应用进入规模化落地阶段，字节跳动正在通过整合模型、办公软件、云服务资源，构建涵盖模型能力、应用场景、商业交付的一体化AI企业服务体系。
